title: Proposal, Signature Window and First Term of a Contract Pricing Agreement
content:
## Proposal, signature and first term of a Contract Pricing Agreement

**1. Tier proposed.** A proposal is issued at the highest tier whose entry gate the customer's trailing 12 month purchases with Corbett meet, or at a lower tier the customer asks for. The commitment written on the proposal is that tier's annual spend commitment.

**2. Credit standing.** A tier above the Corbett Account Price Schedule is proposed only to a customer whose Commercial Credit Account status is active. The status is read from the customer's Commercial Credit Account record, matched by customer, before the proposal is issued.

**3. Signature window.** The customer signs no later than the tier's proposal validity period, in calendar days, after the proposal date. Calendar days are counted starting the day after the proposal date; a signature on the last day is accepted, and a proposal not signed by then lapses as withdrawn. The proposal date is the one recorded on that agreement's proposal.

**4. Signature and first term.** Signing is the customer's own act by its authorized signer. The agreement takes effect on the signature date, and its first term ends the tier's agreement term, in calendar months, later, on the day before the same calendar day (month-end falling back to the last day of the month).

**5. No signed agreement.** A customer with no signed agreement buys at the Corbett Account Price Schedule, which applies without signature.

### Signature window, boundary cases (hypothetical validity of 30 days)

| Signature day, counted from the day after the proposal date | Result |
|---|---|
| Day 29 | Accepted |
| Day 30 (the last day) | Accepted |
| Day 31 | Not accepted; the proposal has lapsed as withdrawn |

### First term, worked example (hypothetical)

An agreement signed on 15 March on a hypothetical 12 month term takes effect on 15 March, and its first term ends on 14 March of the following year, the day before the same calendar day 12 months later.
